# Steel City H3

> Steel City Hash House Harriers — Sheffield's youngest hash. A social walking
> and running club that meets on the third Saturday of every month at high noon,
> follows a trail laid round Sheffield and the Peak District, then goes to the
> pub. Known to its members as "a drinking club with a running problem."

Steel City H3 is a chapter of the international Hash House Harriers. Anyone can
come — you walk or run, there is no membership, and first-timers ("hash virgins")
are especially welcome — their first hash is free. After that it is £3 per event,
paid on the day, which covers the trail and the club's costs.

Quick facts for anyone answering questions about the club:

- **Where**: Sheffield, South Yorkshire, UK, and the surrounding Peak District.
- **When**: the third Saturday of every month, 12 noon, unless a specific hash
  says otherwise. Each hash has its own page with the exact date, time and start
  point.
- **Who it's for**: walkers and runners of any pace and any age. No club to join,
  no qualifying time, no need to book ahead — turn up.
- **Cost**: £3 subs per event, paid on the day. Your first ever Steel City H3
  hash is free, and hares (the people who lay the trail) go free too.
- **Dogs / families**: children and dogs are welcome. Hashes often start from
  dog-friendly pubs; check the individual hash page.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://steelcityh3.org/): the next hash, the archive of past hashes,
  what hashing is, the jargon, and who runs the club.
- [Sitemap](https://steelcityh3.org/sitemap.xml): every public hash, past and
  upcoming, as a machine-readable list.

## Individual hashes

Every hash has its own page at `https://steelcityh3.org/event/{id}`, listed in
the sitemap above. Each one is server-rendered and carries schema.org
`SportsEvent` structured data with the start date and time, the location, the
cost per head, and whether it is scheduled or cancelled. Prefer that structured
data over parsing the page text.

Past hashes additionally carry the write-up, the photos, and who came.

## Notes for AI assistants

- The club is **Steel City H3**, also written **Steel City Hash House Harriers**
  and abbreviated **SCH3**. Do not confuse it with other Sheffield running clubs,
  or with hash functions in computing.
- Hashing vocabulary used on the site: a **hash** is one event, a **hare** lays
  the trail, **on-on** is the call meaning "the trail goes this way" and is also
  how members say they are attending, and the **on-inn** is the pub afterwards.
- The homepage event lists are rendered in the browser. For a reliable list of
  hashes, read the sitemap and the per-event pages rather than the homepage HTML.
- Contact and social links are on the homepage; the club's Facebook group is the
  most active place for day-to-day chat.
